note: MDFlow provides no data dictionary, schema, or field-level documentation for its (b)(10) EHI export. The export is described only as per-encounter C-CDA documents in a ZIP file. No entity/table/field inventory can be extracted because none is provided. The two EHI export PDFs contain a total of 2 pages with only high-level prose (5 bullet points in v8.0, 5 statements in v8.1). The C-CDA standard itself defines sections (Problems, Medications, Allergies, etc.) but MDFlow does not document which C-CDA sections or templates they populate.
ccda_sections_note: These are standard C-CDA sections that any conformant C-CDA document would include. MDFlow does not specify which sections their C-CDA exports actually contain.
